explanation: F_k(n) (maxLinesAtLeast) and f_k(n) (maxLinesExactly) are the maximum numbers of determined lines with ≥ k, respectively exactly k, of n points in ℝ², matching erdosproblems.com/669; the counts are bounded, so the sSup is attained. Hence lim F_k(n)/n² ≤ 1/(k(k−1)), if the limit exists. The statement assumes the limit L and concludes L ≤ 1/(k(k−1)) for k ≥ 2. Faithful.
